post.summary: Chat entrypoint: routes UIRequest to the LangGraph manager
post.description:
Contract:
  UIRequest → (workshops_ai.graph.manager:route_chat) → UIResponse

Safety guarantees:
- Strict Pydantic v2 validation (fail-closed).
- Message length guard (MAX_MESSAGE_LEN).
- Unified timeout (CHAT_TIMEOUT_SEC).
- Backward-compatible acceptance of legacy ChatIn (auto-bridged).
- DI: manager receives GraphDeps via make_default_deps() with a centralized llm_client.
- Language lock: Accept-Language (payload/header) persisted per user/thread (TTL ~30m).
- Context hydration: try to source missing staging/active_tab/language from WS hub.
- Fully defensive around optional UIRequest attributes (getattr + safe setters).

post.description:
Single SSOT-aligned endpoint for all asset tools.
Strictly validates arguments via ToolRegistry to ensure schema parity.
  - asset.list         → handled here (backend list)
  - asset.list_types   → handled here (catalog list from backend)
  - asset.get          → handled here (fetch by id or name)
  - asset.update_meta  → delegated to graph runner (slot-driven + ChangeSet)
  - asset.create       → delegated to graph runner (slot-driven + ChangeSet)
  - asset.explain      → delegated to graph runner (RAG/LLM)

AgentEvent.title: AgentEvent
AgentEvent.description:
Canonical event envelope broadcast by agents over WsHub.

Notes:
- Fail-closed (extra fields are forbidden).
- Timestamps are UTC and timezone-aware.
- `data` is an agent-specific payload (validated by the emitting agent).
- Minimal and stable schema; UIResponse.agent_events may echo these synchronously.

id.title: Id
id.description: UUID v7 of an existing asset. Omit or set to null when creating a new asset.

name.title: Name
name.description: Localized asset name, using the language specified by the user.

description.title: Description
description.description: Localized asset description, using the language specified by the user.

isPrimary.title: Isprimary
isPrimary.description: Indicates if the asset is a primary (business-critical) or supporting asset. This property cannot be changed for existing assets that have UUID. For supporting assets, confidentiality, integrity, and availability must be set to null.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Confidentiality level based on ISO 27001. Must not be translated or localized.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: Integrity level based on ISO 27001. Must not be translated or localized.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Availability level based on ISO 27001. Must not be translated or localized.

assetType.title: Assettype
assetType.description: Asset type from a fixed code list. Must not be translated or localized.

impact_code.title: Impact Code
impact_code.description: Impact code from state (canonical or tenant-specific)

threat_code.title: Threat Code
threat_code.description: Threat code from state (canonical or tenant-specific)

needs_commit.title: Needs Commit
needs_commit.description: True if there are changes waiting for commit.

diff.title: Diff
diff.description: Staged diff preview (shape defined by backend).

StagingState.title: StagingState
StagingState.description:
Staging state returned to the UI:
- needs_commit: should the UI display an explicit commit action?
- batch_id: identifier of the current staging batch (if any)
- diff: backend-defined diff preview (machine/human friendly)

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Assistant lines to render: strings or JSON DTO dumps.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: Structured payload for UI widgets; if present, the UI should render it.

agent_events.title: Agent Events
agent_events.description: Agent tool events echoed with the response for live progress rendering.

policy.description: Response policy hints for the UI (e.g., whether changes emission is enabled).

UIResponse.title: UIResponse
UIResponse.description:
Chat output contract delivered to the UI.
The UI should:
  - Always render `messages` (strings or JSON DTOs).
  - Prefer `proposals` for structured widgets (tables/cards/forms).
  - Optionally show `agent_events` as a live activity log when present.
  - Use `staging` to display commit/diff UX where applicable.

emit_changes_enabled.title: Emit Changes Enabled
emit_changes_enabled.description: If true, the UI may assume WS events/changeset submission are active.

UIResponsePolicy.title: UIResponsePolicy
UIResponsePolicy.description:
Policy hints flowing back to the UI alongside the response.
Useful when the backend derives policy state dynamically and the UI should adapt.
